name: io.wisetrack.sdk.unity
description:
WiseTrack analytics and attribution SDK for Unity (Android).

Requires External Dependency Manager for Unity (EDM4U) to resolve the Android native SDK. See the README for installation steps.

samples.description: Two scenes and scripts demonstrating initialization, events, screen tracking, deep links and logging. Optional Firebase (FCM) code is enabled with the WISETRACK_FIREBASE scripting define.
